Your photo stays private.

While we’re testing, photos stay inside your open browser tab. Before real orders open, we’ll clearly say where images are processed, when they’re deleted, and how a parent can remove them.

If the book is for a child, you must be their parent or guardian, or have permission from one.

Good questions.

Do I pay before seeing anything?

No. You see their character and one story page first. No card is needed for that.

Will the character actually look like them?

You see the full-body character on its own first. Compare the face, hair, skin tone and smile, then approve it or ask for one change.

Can I write my own story idea?

Yes. Choose “My idea” and describe what should happen. One clear sentence is enough.

Who can the books be made for?

Anyone. Pick a reading level from ages 3 to 5 up to adult, and we adjust the words, tone and detail.

Can I add a gift message?

Yes. At checkout you can add a “gifted from” page and a short message at no extra cost.

Is checkout live yet?

Not yet. The payment screen is a clearly labelled test and cannot charge a card.
